# LikeSwim — Swim Lessons in Miami & South Florida

## About

LikeSwim is a private swim school founded and run by Pavel Levitskiy (also spelled Levitskii), based in the Miami area of South Florida. Pavel is a professional swim coach with over 20 years in competitive swimming and 10+ years of coaching experience. He has trained more than 2,000 students — children, adults, beginners, and competitive athletes.

**Credentials:**
- Russian Master of Sports in swimming
- First place, Russian Federation Swimming Championship (2007)
- Member of the Russian national youth swimming team (2006–2008)
- Multiple-time FINA Swimming World Cup competitor (2009–2010), verified on World Aquatics
- Recipient of the Russian Presidential Award for young athletes

Pavel teaches in **English, Russian, and Hebrew**.

---

## Services

### Private Swim Lessons (in-person)
One-on-one lessons at private pools, condominium pools, and hotel pools across South Florida. Pavel travels to the student's location.

Suitable for:
- Children from age 3
- Adults, including those with fear of water
- Triathletes and competitive swimmers

### Group Lessons
Small-group lessons for up to 4 students. Available for both children and adults.

### Online Coaching
Remote coaching for swimmers anywhere in the world:
- **Technique Analysis** — send a swimming video via WhatsApp or Telegram, receive annotated video feedback and targeted drills
- **Online Program** — personalized training plan with technique explanations and weekly video analysis
- **Personal Coaching** — full ongoing support with twice-weekly video analyses and an individually adjusted weekly plan

## Service Area

Pavel travels to private, condominium, and hotel pools throughout South Florida:

**Primary areas:** Hallandale Beach, Hollywood, Aventura, Sunny Isles Beach, Miami Beach, Miami, Fort Lauderdale

**Also serves:** Coral Gables, Boca Raton, Delray Beach, Boynton Beach, West Palm Beach, Coral Springs, Pompano Beach, Pembroke Pines, Miramar, Davie, Weston

Coverage: Miami to West Palm Beach.

- Reply typically within minutes

**What to include when booking:**

- Who is learning (child with age, or adult)
- Current swimming level
- Your neighborhood or area in South Florida
